scores.evidence_span: Focus on technical details and practical NLP application cases
scores.rationale: Practical AI work is emphasized in application materials, but it is not explicitly stated as a priority for choosing research directions or programs.

No source or evidence class is selected specifically to evaluate whether programs support applied or system-building AI research. GitHub reproduction is a preparation activity, not a program-evaluation method.

The report supplies no concrete, verifiable fact showing how a named option supports applied or system-building research. The regional description of strength in applied AI is only a general characterization.
No named option or route is characterized with a verifiable fact about purely abstract, theory-only research.
The report does not directly compare applied research with theory-only research on a common decision axis.
Recommendations are justified by NLP leadership, employment, funding, proximity, and entry requirements—not by support for applied or system-building research.
Europe is downgraded for degree requirements and financial concerns, not for favoring theory-only research. No other option is downgraded on that basis.
